userRequest: Choose a self-hosted outbound webhook service with retries, signing, and delivery history.
successConditions: Workers persist deliveries, sign payloads, retry failures, and expose delivery history.
All webhook payload and delivery data remains in the existing EU deployment.

identityFacts: Each tenant owns independently rotatable endpoint secrets.
dataFacts: Webhook payloads may contain regulated customer data that must remain in eu-central-1.
operationalFacts: The team can operate a containerized service using the existing PostgreSQL and Redis clusters.

hardConstraints.statement: The deployed service must use an OSI-style permissive license accepted by policy: MIT, BSD, or Apache-2.0.
Payloads and delivery metadata must stay in the self-hosted eu-central-1 environment.
A signing helper alone is insufficient; the candidate must persist, retry, and report delivery attempts.

preferences.statement: Prefer reuse of the existing PostgreSQL and Redis services.

reasonCodes.description: Webhook content must remain within the self-hosted EU environment.
The case requires persistence, retries, signing, and delivery history.
Repository policy accepts only MIT, BSD, or Apache-2.0 for the service.
The candidate can operate inside the supplied PostgreSQL and Redis environment.

unknowns.description: Required worker, PostgreSQL, and Redis capacity has not been load-tested.
